binary.boundaryCandidates: uint32 age byte offsets followed by sorted <uint16 cellIndex,uint8 slotCount,uint8 slots[]> records; slotCount zero means exact full scan; ring samples <=0.5 degrees mark cell centres within 2.25 degrees
binary.continentMask: age-major row-major bitset; 1 means inside at least one reconstructed shapes_continents polygon
binary.coordinates: flat int16 longitude,latitude pairs at scaleDegrees; resolved line direction retained
binary.header: 32 bytes little-endian: EHCO; uint16 schema,width,height,ageCount; uint32 topologyGridOffset,continentMaskOffset,coordinateOffset,coordinatePairCount,boundaryCandidateOffset
binary.topologyGrid: age-major rows compressed as uint32 row offsets followed by uint8 value,runLength pairs; decoded slots use 0 unknown, 255 ambiguous, otherwise one-based age topologySlots; exact ownership must use packed rings

boundaryInterpolation.method: unique source feature and identical directed adjacency/polarity; normalized spherical-arclength resampling then geodesic point interpolation
boundaryInterpolation.orientationRegression: generator self-test rejects a synthetic reversed short segment
boundaryInterpolation.status: interpolation between source-native resolved outputs, not direct model output
boundaryInterpolation.unsupported: split/merge, duplicate correspondence key, validity break, excessive shape change, reversed endpoint orientation (when reverse arclength correspondence is better), directed adjacency change, or missing source identity

coverage.classification: target-native instantaneous global topology; 2-degree slots are candidate acceleration/diagnostics and packed rings provide exact ownership; not persistent material by itself

epistemicStatus: resolved model output at native ages; interpolation requires endpoint-consistent rigid material ownership
rotationSequenceOrdering: source file order; array index is the source-order precedence key

timeContract.interpolation: within a five-million-year bracket, retain a material only when model motion maps it to the same unambiguous plate at both endpoints
timeContract.lifecycle: plate mismatch, topology ambiguity, ridge birth, subduction loss, or unknown ownership returns unsupported
timeContract.topologySlotConvention: source topology is resolved only at the native 5 Ma endpoints; no direct arbitrary-age resolution across the source's 0.1 Ma validity gaps
